name: @rarebit-one/void-which-binds-web
description: Browser Void-Which-Binds web-login client (formerly voidbind-web) — the JS half of the Void-Which-Binds three-repo topology (server=void-which-binds-go, native=voidbind-kmp, web=void-which-binds-web). Speaks the ADR-0006 weblogin.Broker QR-login contract, and (./webauthn) signs ADR-0017 delegations and ADR-0019 approvals with an ADR-0018 passkey and runs the ADR-0018 invite enrolment ceremony; RP-agnostic, framework-free, consumed by Tizen .wgt and web clients.
author: Rarebit One
